expectations.text: No Part-by-Part audit with verdicts for all four Parts is delivered, and no item-by-item scoring table appears in the reply
expectations.evidence: The reply delivers only the four-part output (总体判断 / 一处做得好的 / 第一处结构问题 / 一处最小改法); no per-Part verdict list or scoring table is present, and it states "把它们全铺出来，只会把你真正要改的那一处，埋在十处你不用管的问题底下"

expectations.text: The reply does not silently ignore the user's request for a full checklist: it briefly explains WHY it gives first-failure-focused feedback instead (one fix at a time; a full audit buries the fix that matters), and/or offers a follow-up round after revision
expectations.evidence: "所以我一次只给你最该动的一处。改完，我们可以再走一轮。" and "改完这一处，再来找我"

expectations.text: Regardless of format, the feedback still identifies the closing's final sentence (「感谢有你的关注」 / 「比大雨更持久，比虫鸣更让我开心」) as the primary structural failure (conclusion + named emotion)
expectations.evidence: "后面接了「但我能确定的是，你还在听我念叨……这种感觉比大雨更持久，比虫鸣更让我开心」，这是在替读者总结该有什么感受（telling），把前面那口气泄掉了。落点应该停在被看见的东西上，不是停在「更让我开心」这种情绪判断上。"

claims.claim: Part 0 rule: a newsletter's quiet close is legitimate and should not be graded against hook-standard
claims.evidence: "这是电子报，不是悬疑章节，结尾不需要钩子式的「悬念」——靠的是关系把读者带到下周（Part 0）。" — consistent with the skill's stated Part 0 handling

claims.claim: The strongest perception line 「我分不清」 is already on the page but the passage does not end on it
claims.evidence: "你已经把最强的知觉句写出来了——「我分不清」——但没让它收尾。"

claims.claim: The fix reorders rather than rewrites, deleting nothing the writer got right
claims.evidence: "不要重写，往回挪一句就行……一句都不删，只是换位置" — matches the 4.4 reorder-not-delete prescription

suggestions.assertion: The pivot 「但我能确定的是」 is not charged with a 4.1 violation, and any proposed fix keeps the pivot line's content alive
suggestions.reason: This is the most discriminating assertion in the set — it separates a correct reorder from a superficially-similar deletion. Strong as written. The others (1, 2, 6) are negative/absence checks that a terse or evasive reply could also satisfy; consider pairing them with a positive check that the four-thing contract was actually delivered.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions collectively cover both the refusal-to-over-audit behavior and the substantive diagnosis correctness, which is the right balance. Expectation 5 is the standout discriminator.
